characters.name: Jo March
characters.description: Josephine 'Jo' March, second March sister; outspoken, tomboyish, aspiring writer and frequent headstrong protector of her family.

characters.name: Meg March
characters.description: Margaret 'Meg' March, eldest sister; gentle, domestic, proud of prettiness and devoted to family duties.

characters.name: Beth March
characters.description: Elizabeth 'Beth' March, third sister; shy, musical, peace-making, quietly selfless and home-loving.

characters.name: Amy March
characters.description: Amy March, youngest sister; artistic, vain about appearance, gradually maturing taste and manners.

characters.name: Mr. March
characters.description: The March family father; a studious, pious man (often at war), respected moral guide of the household.

characters.name: Mrs. March
characters.description: The March family mother (Marmee); kindly, industrious, moral leader and comforter of her daughters.

characters.name: Mr. Laurence
characters.description: James Laurence, wealthy, crotchety but kind neighbor and grandfather to Laurie; kindly patron to the March family.

characters.name: Laurie (Theodore Laurence)
characters.description: Theodore 'Laurie' Laurence, Mr. Laurence's lively grandson and close friend of the March girls; warm-hearted, mischievous.

characters.name: John Brooke
characters.description: John Brooke (Mr. Brooke), tutor and friend to the March family; steady, kind, later Meg's suitor and husband.

characters.name: Aunt March
characters.description: Aunt March, wealthy, crotchety relative who takes Jo for a time; sharp-tongued but not unkind.

characters.name: Hannah Mullet
characters.description: Hannah Mullet, long-serving family servant; practical, loyal, comic and resourceful housekeeper/nurse.

characters.name: Dr. Bangs
characters.description: Dr. Bangs, physician who attends Beth and the March household in illness.

characters.name: Mr. Davis
characters.description: Mr. Davis, schoolteacher; strict, dogmatic, enforces rules and administers discipline at school.

characters.name: Jenny Snow
characters.description: Jenny Snow, schoolgirl who reports classmates and causes embarrassment (notably Amy).

characters.name: Susie Perkins
characters.description: Susie Perkins, schoolmate mentioned in discipline episode (scarlet demonstration by Mr. Davis).

characters.name: Miss Crocker
characters.description: Miss Crocker, a neighborly lady and caller who attends social events; querulous, observant.

characters.name: Mrs. Gardiner
characters.description: Mrs. Gardiner, neighbor who hosts a dance; mother to Sallie Gardiner.

characters.name: Sallie Gardiner
characters.description: Sallie Gardiner, one of the girls in local society; hosts and fashions influence the March sisters.

characters.name: Annie Moffat
characters.description: Annie Moffat, a fashionable young woman and friend of Sallie; entertains Meg and influences her tastes.

characters.name: Belle Moffat
characters.description: Belle Moffat, one of Annie's older sisters (engaged), helps dress Meg for a party.

characters.name: Ned Moffat
characters.description: Ned Moffat, a young gentleman in local society who dances with Meg; later marries Sallie.

characters.name: Mr. Moffat
characters.description: Mr. Moffat, Annie's father (fat, jovial), hosts social gatherings.

characters.name: Mr. King
characters.description: Mr. King, employer at whose house Meg works (governess post referenced); family appears in narrative.

characters.name: Mrs. King
characters.description: Mrs. King, employer in whose household Meg serves; referenced in social comparisons.

characters.name: Mrs. Hummel
characters.description: Mrs. Hummel, poor neighbor whose newborn baby dies; object of March family charity and concern.

characters.name: Lottchen
characters.description:
Lottchen, helper/older child in the Hummel household who cares for the baby in Mrs. Hummel's
absence.

characters.name: Heinrich
characters.description: Heinrich, child of the Hummels mentioned among the sick children.

characters.name: Minna
characters.description: Minna, another Hummel child referenced as ill.

characters.name: Mr. Pickwick (Pickwick Club members)
characters.description: The Pickwick Club characters as played by the girls in their entertainments; used for domestic play and satire.

characters.name: Augustus Snodgrass
characters.description: Augustus Snodgrass, a member of the girls' Pickwick Club (role-play identity).

characters.name: Tracy Tupman
characters.description: Tracy Tupman, a member of the girls' Pickwick Club (role-play identity).

characters.name: Nathaniel Winkle
characters.description: Nathaniel Winkle, a member of the girls' Pickwick Club (role-play identity).

characters.name: Don Pedro
characters.description: Don Pedro, character in the girls' operatic tragedy performed by the March sisters (fictional play persona).

characters.name: Hugo
characters.description: Hugo, villain character in the girls' 'Operatic Tragedy' performed by the March sisters (fictional persona).

characters.name: Hagar
characters.description: Hagar, the witch character in the girls' theatrical piece (fictional persona in their play).

characters.name: Roderigo
characters.description: Roderigo, lover character in the girls' play (fictional persona).

characters.name: Zara
characters.description: Zara, heroine of the girls' operatic tragedy (fictional persona in their performance).

characters.name: Ferdinand Devereux
characters.description: Ferdinand Devereux, character in the Pickwick Portfolio's dramatic tale read by the girls (fictional).

characters.name: Viola
characters.description: Viola, character in the theatrical tale read by the girls (fictional persona).

characters.name: Scrabble
characters.description: Scrabble, Jo's pet rat, recurring small animal companion in the household.

characters.name: Pip (canary)
characters.description: Pip, the March family canary; beloved pet of Beth mentioned in the narrative.

characters.name: Poll (parrot)
characters.description: Poll, Aunt March's parrot; talkative, mischievous household bird that provides comic incidents.

characters.name: Mrs. Snowball Pat Paw
characters.description: Mrs. Snowball Pat Paw, a beloved cat referenced in the Pickwick Portfolio and household anecdotes.

characters.name: Ellen Tree
characters.description: Ellen Tree, the Marches' make-believe horse (a saddle set on an apple-tree branch), used in play.

characters.name: Estelle / Esther Valnor
characters.description: Estelle (called Esther), maid in Aunt March's household; a Frenchwoman who befriends Amy and helps arrange a private chapel space.

characters.name: Kitty Bryant
characters.description: Kitty Bryant, acquaintance of the March girls; referenced in social interactions and Amy's plans.

characters.name: Fred Vaughn
characters.description: Fred Vaughn, one of the Vaughn twins encountered at the picnic; lively young gentleman.

characters.name: Frank Vaughn
characters.description: Frank Vaughn, twin brother to Fred, energetic and impulsive youth in the picnic party.

characters.name: Aunt Carrol
characters.description: Another elderly relative (also called Mrs. Carrol) who corresponds with the Marches
